lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit. The spots exhibit a regular spatial frequency with wider horizontal spacing between columns than vertical spacing between individual spots within a single column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a distinct grid-like architecture on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible running across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity transition from light (top) to shadow (bottom).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs within the first dorsal fin silhouette, primarily visible along the anterior and middle sections of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly organized spot patterning on the visible pectoral fin, consisting of approximately four distinct vertical columns of high-intensity white spots.
